status: Exploratory heterogeneous comparison. Raw observations and derived mass estimators retain different systematic assumptions. No universal-DM or memory detection claim.

inputs.population_definition: CLASH inner BCG and outer cluster points share one training population and one group per cluster. Classical/ultrafaint dwarfs share dSph training population and are reported separately. MaNGA and CLASH redshift ranges do not overlap. Known names normalized across SPARC/ETG. Two nearby MaNGA BCGs (8989-12703 and8991-6102;2.694arcmin,delta_z.002943) conservatively share a validation group because a common hostenvironment is possible; host identities are not fully documented.
inputs.reserved_inputs: X-COP fixed-radius profiles remain a separate prior-inspected stress test; no X-COP R500 points. KiDS/GAMA stacked lensing have no unique physical radius; separate external one-input tests. Group dispersions are separate global virial observables. Globular central-dispersion data are controls, not pooled local RAR points.
inputs.limitations: Fixed-input heterogeneous estimators; no errors-in-variables or covariance inference. Physical system folds do not hold out shared MilkyWay/M31 environments, which receive a separate sensitivity check. Some shared calibration/survey uncertainties remain across folds.
inputs.sensitivity: Post-search sensitivity: retain only25dSph with maxquoteddispersionerror/sigma<=0.25 and no source caution flag; allotherpopulations unchanged. Not an independentconfirmatorytest.

training: Equal population total weights; equal validation-group weights within each population; equal radial point weights within group. dSph subtypes share one training population. Two nearby MaNGA BCGs conservatively share a group.
validation: Five physical-system folds,3innerfolds for shared-familyselection; seed20261027,innerseed39173+outerfold. Known same systems across sources are grouped. Not all dwarfs in samehost are grouped; hostenvironment sensitivity separately.

model_definitions.RAR_potential_quad: same quadratic in q=x+u; potential proxy only
model_definitions.RAR_density_quad: same quadratic in q=x-u; density proxy only
model_definitions.RAR_piecewise: standard RAR with one loga0 per population, population order given
